name: LDAP latency by site
description: Average of latest measurements per selected source computer and target DC; green 0 ms to red 2000 ms.
kql:
LatencyReports_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, TargetDC
| extend Series = strcat(SourceSite, " -> ", TargetSite)
| summarize Value = avg(Latency_ms), Timestamp = max(TimeGenerated) by Series
